notes.title: Different Endings Update released!
notes.content:
The final two endings are uncovered in the latest update to Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder. 

One new ending finishes the story that the in-game comic started, how Clayton destroyed the civilization of the Elder Lizards and killed their King. Now comes accountability, and maybe even absolution.

The other is a fun one about Chompys, the living chests who for inexplicable reasons have invaded the Cave Digger world. Some creatures are best kept on a tight leash, but now it is too late as you will see!

notes.title: Free Major Expansion! Return of the Chompys
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=acmYSbO1XXE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Welcome to the New Frontier, Prospectors! [/h1]

Howdy frontier miners! Welcome to the new update, the Return of the Chompys.  
We are releasing a long waited update with tons of different features! For Free!
New endings, new gameplay methods, new enemies, and most importantly, MORE CHOMPYS! 

Please welcome the new addition to our Chompy Family. [b]Hellraiser Chompy, Punk Chompy, and Miner Chompy![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/45b773e57e6d7638e1775ddf3893f572c448d6c8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hellraiser Chompy[/h3] is a demoniac monstrosity from the hell dimensions! He’s big, mean and spiky, and make no mistake: this guy is here to hunt you down! You better run as fast as you can to get out of its sight.

[h3]Punk Chompy[/h3] might not be as terrifying to look at, but she’s definitely bringing the chaos! Armed with Molotov cocktails, this Chompy will destroy everything on her way. She’s the definition of rebellious and unpredictable. I guess this is the result of being overworked.!

[h3]Miner Chompy[/h3] is the other side of the coin. Similar to the original Chompy in the first Cave Digger, this guy will team up with you in the mine. He can dig out walls for you, and deliver riches straight to your account. With Miner Chompy around, backpack space won't be a problem and I'm sure he will become your favorite companion in no time.

We added [b]RUN GENERATORS[/b] so you can now decide what perils await you in the mines deep below. Will you find more riches? Get more enemies? Find natural disasters? The elevator now has a run generator that allows you to roll for run modifiers before heading down into the mines. This means that you’ll have some control over your prospecting work in the search of riches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/e33dd9b92a6cbb3c638efb27647bfc53db1b9d84.jpg[/img]

But of course we’ve added more than just Chompys to the game. A new mysterious enemy type is stalking the caves, the Drone Construct. 
These ancient devices will often remain cloaked until you step too close. Keep your eyes open and prepare to deflect their plasma blasts! They are a guardian of the Eerie Ruins, and will try to stop any intruders to the mysterious halls and caverns there...

notes.title: Full release on 8th of September!
notes.content:
Howdy cave diggers!

On September 14th, 2021, we released Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder on Steam Early Access. We did it to test the game on a bigger audience and receive valuable feedback from our dedicated VR prospectors. Now it's finally time to release the full version of the game!

First things first, the price will go up at the full release so now it's a good time to purchase the game with the early access discount and invite your friends to join in.

And let's talk a bit about the biggest changes coming...

[b]Pan[/b]

Slotting the pan in the arm slots will now transform it into a shield! Quite handy against those plasma shrimp projectiles.

Using the gold pan is also now considerably easier and faster.

Three new completely unique endings will be added. Not spoiling anything about those yet.

notes.title: Community Contest #3
notes.content:
Like that song from the rat who cooks food by pulling a man's hair, it’s time to sortez les bouteilles, fini les ennuis! It’s time for our third community contest for Cave Digger 2: Dig HARDER! ⛏️

Since we have more influx of people due to steam summer sales plus the summer vacation, we decided to host the 3rd community contest today! 

Alright, so here’s how it works. You’ll get to show us your in-game fashion in Cave Digger 2. The judges (devs) will decide who has the most creative, funny, and interesting fashion sense. Whoever wins will receive a custom discord role as a reward along with a mystery box delivered to their location! We'll also select one winner at random. 

[h2][b]SHOW US YOUR DRIP[/b][/h2]
Cave Digger 2: Dig harder already has so many interesting costumes and cosmetics that you can combine together to represent who you want to be in the game. You can be a rough cowboy in the frontiers, a boxed Chompy head guy, deformed fish barbarian, and even an e-girl! YOU can choose who you want to be when you want. 

You should be aware by now, but If you’re not already familiar with it, after purchasing the cabin, you can enter and change your costume in front of a mirror. For example, my usual drip is the hunter set with an antler hat! 

You shouldn’t limit yourself to only costumes though. You’re welcome to add other props to your contents. There is no set scenery either, so if you got a friend in the discord or irl, grab em and take a picture together! Your imagination is your limit. Just show us the most creative screenshot or a video you can take.

[h1][b]“The key to style is learning who you are, which takes years. There's no how-to road map to style. It's about self-expression and, above all, attitude." —Iris Apfel[/b][/h1]

That being said, read the rules for more info and show us what you got! ːsteamhappyː


[h2]RULES[/h2]

To enter the contest, follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@vrkiwi]Tiktok[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/vr_kiwi]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/cavediggergame]Facebook[/url], and post a screenshot or a short video clip of your best in-game costume on the discord #community-contest under Cave Digger 2. 
You can also post in Twitter, Facebook, and Tiktok. MAKE SURE TO INCLUDE #ShowUsYourCaveDrip when posting in other channels than discord and DM us when you do! 
You will be able to submit multiple entries, meaning you can submit multiple pictures or videos! 
Do feel free to include props and other scenarios. It doesn’t matter what you include as long as you keep common sense and don’t put anything illegal, hateful, or explicit content.
By submitting your work, you agree that your photo or video can be used on our social media for promotional purposes. 

[h2]REWARDS[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Custom discord role[/b]
[*] [b]A mystery package [/b]
[/list]

Three winners will be hand chosen by the devs (our favorites) and one winner will be randomly selected from all the submissions! 

[b]DEADLINE:[/b] All the entries must be submitted by midnight (GMT) on Sunday, July 24th, 2022.

DISCLAIMER: [i]Staff picks are chosen by the VRkiwi staff and our decision is final. Prizes are non-negotiable, non-refundable and non-transferable. Any prizes left unclaimed seven days after the announcement of the winners are forfeit[/i]

notes.title: Randolph W. Akeley's Logbook
notes.content:
[i]There's been a lotta talk among the old diggers here. A lotta talk about weird things and goings on in the deep caves and tunnels of these here mountains, about peculiar machines that hum without sound and make the inside of your skull itch as you look at them.

Since old mountain men are an ornery, disagreeable lot, no consensus has been reached as to what them things are. Most concur that they're an ill omen, some black magic better left hidden in the bowels of the earth. Some of the less hardy folk have even upped stakes and hit the road again, rather than deal with the weird secrets below.

I never thought that there could be anythin' worse than those damn lizards lurkin' in the mines.

One of the miners who scarpered left behind an incoherent note for the rest of us. I found it on the countin' table the next morning, next to this strange symbol he'd carved into the wood, with his fingernails by the looks of it. The note said "Drocsid etagitsevni! June 22. P." which obviously ain't any kinda English I've ever read. I copied the symbol here as well, just in case I come across it again later.

I hope I don't.[/i]

- Randolph W. Akeley

notes.content:
[h1]Update 2: Escape from the Valley[/h1]

[previewyoutube=54dSk4mb7GY;full]
[/previewyoutube]

Escape from the valley is a major content update for Cave Digger 2: Dig harder. The update makes the game bigger, better and more dangerous than it was before. A new biome brings new challenges and the tools get new mechanics! We've listened to the player feedback and made many general improvements and quality of life changes. Watch the video and read below to know more.


[h2]The First Ending[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/69be970934b30278bfd0f58a60f116e20dd5cac5.png[/img]

CD1 was known by it's multiple endings so of course we're bringin that back in CD2. The first of the endings is now in the game. I'm not gonna spoil you anything, but let's say the update's name is a hint. You'll find more clues around the game!

You'll be able to continue the game normally after the ending credits play. It's not really an ending, more just an ending to a story-line.


[h2]Biome 3 - The Nest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/d234ef07c96dbbcc08758d736669d54d7b201d74.png[/img]

Following Clayton's footsteps to the dry lake bed, player finds their way to the nest biome underneath. This biome takes a proper use of the climbing mechanics we introduced in the halloween patch as an experimental feature. It's more mysterious, dangerous and rich than the biomes before...


[h2]New enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/21fd1443f8983c530dbf6998e0425da223e9f0e7.png[/img]

[b]Primal Chameleon[/b]
The standard enemy encounter in the Nest. Watch out for it's strong tail, long tongue and surprisingly precise throwing arm.

[b]Thieving Chameleon[/b]
The sneaky friend of the Primal Chameleon. The Thieving Chameleon will sneak up on you cloaked, and will try to steal your loot. Watch out!


[h2]Tool upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/a55c4a2090257486904847cd5489825476f049fc.png[/img]

[b]Worker's Glove[/b]
The glove gets it's first upgrade. Purchasing this upgrade will let you "vacuum" the treasures laying nearby, making it easier to collect big amounts of loot quickly.

[b]Sledgehammer[/b]
The sledgehammer rocks the caves now with a rocket upgrade. Small yet powerful thrusters are welded on it, making the hammer more powerful, but also enabling the player to fly short distances. The players can reach treasures up in the ceiling or escape hordes of enemies using this!

[b]Revolver[/b]
The revolver upgrade adds exploding bullets. Light it up with your handy finger lighter and shoot! You can use it to mine small holes of course, but it's a very effective weapon in combat.

[b]Dynamite[/b]
The dynamite gets sticky with the latest upgrades. Stick it up your digging hole, or any wall, weapon or an enemy for a big and strategic boom.


[h2]List of all the improvements[/h2]

notes.title: Upcoming update: The Escape from the Valley
notes.content:
Howdy, prospectors! 

Soon it is time for another content update: The Escape from the Valley! The exact date is not yet locked in, but we'll let you know as soon as we know. Here's a brief sneak peek of what is coming. We'll post another article at the release with more details, as well as a developer update video. 

Lately, we have been streaming the content from this patch on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/vrkiwigaming]twitch channel[/url], so you might've seen some of this stuff already. Anyways...


[h2]The Escape from the Valley ending:[/h2]

The first ending of many to come. I suppose the name hints something, but that's all the spoilers for now. The player's will find clues in the world to figure out this one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/1d2c048aae5049f081cb35dbd096f29aca1ac7c5.png[/img]

The player will find their way to the third biome, a dry lake bed on which the player's base camp is located. Underneath lies the nest biome, introducing new game mechanics, dangers and loot. The climbing and jumping will finally come in handy here!

[/h2]

notes.title: Just a little seasonal update
notes.content:
[h2]Ho-ho-howdy, diggers!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/ecd06b10f7717514d6f4b3939c4a07b08ef544d4.jpg[/img]

The holiday season arrives to the valley and we have a small gift for you so you can celebrate even in the mines while searching for the glimmering stones. 

You can now dress up as Nuuttipukki, a traditional Finnish character, who is comparable to Santa Claus. A young man might dress up as a goat (pukki) on Saint Knut's day and visit houses, demanding food and [i]especially[/i] leftover alcoholic beverages. If he didn't get what he wanted, Nuuttipukki would commit evil deeds.

The costume would usually consist of an inverted jacket, a bark mask, and horns. Nuuttipukki is also similar to Krampus, who is a scary character from central European folklore.


Also, if you haven't read last week's announcement, we're now also working on Quest release on Oculus App Lab and SideQuest alongside the next big content update for Steam and Oculus platforms! With the Oculus App Lab release, crossplay coop is also coming which will be great for both random matchmakers and friend groups teaming up over different platforms.

Also in that announcement, we released the latest Cave Digger 2 OST song "Watch me go" last Saturday on our YouTube channel so recommend checking it out!


And of course,[url=discord.gg/cavedigger] join our discord[/url], if you haven't yet!

Cave Digger 2 team wishes everyone happy holiday season!

notes.title: Cave Digger 2: Dig harder releases on Early Access!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uaEXDHojt0c;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy to announce that Cave Digger 2: Dig harder has been released on Steam Early Access.

Counting the pre-production phase, it's been about a year since we started working on the game. The journey has been exciting, interesting, scary, and full of surprises. Overall, the whole development period has been very different in comparison to Cave Digger 1. As our budget grew, the game and the team grew with it. All of this brought us so many new opportunities and challenges. 

When we released CD1 in summer of 2018, none of us could even imagine that we'd be here doing this three years later. Thank you all for supporting us by purchasing our games, being active in the online communities and spreading the word.

[h1]Early Access launch content[/h1]


[h2]Two biomes to explore[/h2]

[h3]1. The Base Camp[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/09c8ea2a6017d6af40f8f82117f7f3185d080897.jpg[/img]

Your base camp is set on the surface of the Valley biome. A wintery landscape with surrounding mountains, water and at night a beautiful starry sky. The underground is a natural looking rocky set of caves. It's procedurally generated so each run is a bit different! Same goes for the rest of the undergrounds.



[h3]2. The Hot Springs[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/090d2ccc3eee677e2e32565f92d06fd145869328.jpg[/img]

When you enter the second biome, your base camp will be located in a valley containing hot springs. Definitely a warming experience after all the snow and ice in the first area. In the mines of the hot springs, you’ll find a coral biome with many new treasures and challenges.


More biomes are in the development.

[h2]5 tools & upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/7d69656fdf856cce7695aff7dfc72627a7fbcc74.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Pickaxe
[*] Sledgehammer
[*] Scanner
[*] Dynamite 
[*] Revolver
[/list]
Each upgrade will make the tool more effective for their intended or unintended purposes. Also they’ll get some cosmetic changes for bragging rights. More tools and upgrades will be added soon!


[h2]Co-op multiplayer support[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/f6597fc52e37966d46181e7b3ee221a65e668370.jpg[/img]

You can play alone, or you can create a party of 4 people (or less) and go diggin’ together. You can directly invite your Steam friends, or you can create a room with a code and share the code with the people you want to play with.


[h2]Character customization[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/4350362f9ddf830ea1ab43edb0c7be1d72288e9e.jpg[/img]

In the base camp’s cabin, you’ll find a mirror. Customize your in-game avatar by changing the hats, head, hair and body styles. More options will be added later, but there should be plenty now to start with!


[h1]Here’s our vague roadmap for the upcoming months![/h1]


Update 1: The Grave Digger

Update 2: Escape from Valley

Update 3: The Rock Bottom

Update 4: The Final Update


Note: The price of the game will increase later on as we keep on adding more content. At the moment we think that the price represents the content and the quality of the game. Stay tuned for updates!

Anyways... Off to the mines we go!

notes.title: Community design contest #2
notes.content:
Hello from the frontiers of the new country! It’s time for our second community contest for Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! 

After the Steam next fest and CD1 super sales, our lil’ community grew again so here we go. You’ll get to showcase your ideas and creativity again and we’ll pick the best option(s) and add it into the game. The winner will also get a copy of Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! on Steam when it becomes available on Early Access on Aug 31st.

[h2]DESIGN A RELIC
[/h2]
Cave Digger 2: Dig harder! will have heaps of interesting and unique relics that the players can dig up. Basically we’re recycling the artifacts from CD1 but just named them relics now. If you’re not already familiar with it, CD2 takes place in an unexplored valley with rough weather and deep mines in a weird wild west country. However, the relics are not limited to the world of Cave Digger. Who knows how they got there anyway!? For example it could be a lost photo from Clayton’s holiday trip, or a forbidden spellbook or alien technology from another universe! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/6474c9823833601b2c4c4d8ba9dfe3ab9f6e582b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/144094c2a8982b62efa93f0e084707fd36252a34.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/f6b804ece06547bebee7ac1e550503bcb6ef706e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/48baba455468147f7020be69f2386e3e00ba578a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/fd608892376d95801e690196b9acf0e0663829c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/182008418e34e37b67fc383a3b719d727b537183.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/b451afd4c03ee6602e0d17d844c68950922f8ac2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/725269ff4a79a178ea7281533e2b817966030894.png[/img][/url]
[i]These are some of the relics we've already designed.[/i]


The Relic’s size should be something that you can grab and hold on to comfortably in Virtual Reality. The Relics generally don’t have any functionality, but you can suggest some small functions and we’ll consider adding it. You can also design some simple visual effects like flashing lights or short sound effects to take it to the next level! 

First and foremost we’d love to see the designs in the form of art. Drawings, photoshops, 3d models and things like that. Come up with a catchy name for the relic, and a flavor text (i.e. “This old flashlight is rusty and all out of batteries!”). The drawings don’t have to be super good, as long as you can get the idea of what the relic should look like. Our artists will be able to turn them into something usable in the game. If you are absolutely unable to produce anything visual, describe it in the best possible way. However, the visual submissions will probably have a higher chance of winning.

Understand that we might need to change a part of your design to make it fit the game world.

“[i]We could imagine nothing pleasanter than to spend all of our lives digging for relics of the past.[/i]”
― Heinrich Schliemann

That being said, read the rules and start designing! 


[h2]RULES
[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Relic design does NOT represent any copyrighted material. Your design can be inspired by famous objects, but change it a bit just like you would copy your friend’s homework.
[*] The Relic design does NOT represent any illegal, hateful, overly violent or explicit content. You know, use common sense.
[*] The design must be submitted by midnight (GMT) on Sunday August 29th 2021.
[*] The submission must include an image of the design or a written description in a way that our artists can work based on it.
[*] By submitting your work you agree that VRKiwi can use your design in Cave Digger 2: Dig harder as they please.
[/list]


[h2]HOW TO SUBMIT
[/h2]

Post your designs in the comments or in our discord server’s #community-contest channel [url=https://discord.gg/cavedigger]https://discord.gg/cavedigger[/url]

notes.content:
Howdy, diggers! The demo is now available on Steam. Please read below to understand what to expect from the game build.

[h3]Demo content[/h3]

For the first public testing of the game we wanted to focus on the basics:
[list]
[*]3 mining tools: a pickaxe, a dynamite and a scanner
[*]A revolver
[*]The first biome (random generated levels based on rooms)
[*]A couple of nasty creatures...
[/list]

[h3]The state of the game[/h3]

So we've been developing the game for about 6 months or so. We've come far but it's still a work in progress. What you will be able to play this week, is a demo build for the Early Access version which will be released in Q3. It is likely you will encounter bugs, especially you who are going to play multiplayer.

The more you report the bugs and provide feedback on the game, the more it will help us developing the game further into something great.

[h3]How to report bugs[/h3]

You can report bugs directly in-game by opening the options and navigating to "Report". You can also leave general feedback there if you want to.

The usual channels on Steam community forums and our [b][url=discord.gg/cavedigger]discord server[/url][/b] will also work great. We'll be reading them all!
